tier: T1-class open loop (self-action: the arm is conditioned on its OWN held upper-layer outputs, never on GT); the lead's logged future does not react, so 'closes on the lead' means 'closes on where the lead was'
estimator: taniteval.ci.episode_cluster_bootstrap / paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap, B 2000, seed 0, over EPISODES; delta = a - b; answers 'another draw of EPISODES' only
lead_agent_layer: lead track = published PhysicalAI-AV `obstacle.offline` via taniteval/tools/build_lead_block_b1.py (B1 per-frame block, 147 v7.2 EVAL clips); NOT the augmented v7.x label release; NOT the v9 scalar lead labels of lead_eval139.npz
no_bar_registered: no distance-keeping bar is registered for v8F-mini: nothing here is PASS / FAIL; a positive delta = MORE gap/time/TTC, not 'better'

definitions.lead_viol_at_risk: registered LEAD-VIOL: plan time gap < 1.0 s on lead windows where the HUMAN keeps >= 1.0 s
